comparator.rule: tree arms must beat T0, not merely P3-log5

population: Phase 6 reconciled PA population (identical rows all arms); 2023 folds for selection; 2024 E1/E2 one development evaluation; no 2025/2026
feature_manifest: frozen F1-F5 + trip/index terms from logistic_pa/bundle/feature_manifest.json; F6_rest EXCLUDED; no repertoire/velocity/movement; no new interactions

T1.selection: 2023 chronological folds (same F1/F2 boundaries as Phase 7), mean fold eval logloss, subject to Brier + calibration + fold consistency

T2.model: LightGBM + monotone constraints where semantics defensible
T2.constraints: increasing in batter/pitcher K-tendency inputs only if T1 qualifies; registered before fitting

T3.authorization: ONLY if 2023 OOF errors of the qualifying tree arm and L3 show complementarity (registered correlation/coverage test on 2023 folds); weighting selected on 2023 only; never because reused-2024 score improves

promote_tree: beats T0 PA logloss in BOTH E1 and E2 with 100%-consistent date-cluster bootstrap direction
no calibration collapse (registered slope range 0.9-1.1 diagnostic)
survives oracle aggregation (start-level MAE paired CI excludes 0 favoring tree in both blocks)
fold-stable: gains in both 2023 selection folds
stop: tree ties or loses to T0 -> retain logistic, stop complexity escalation
calibration slope outside registered range with no registered correction

metrics: same as Phase 7 (logloss primary, Brier, calibration diagnostics, reliability, slices, paired bootstraps date+game_pk, oracle aggregation)
interpretation_limits: 2024 remains development evidence; no frozen-model, market, or deployability claim
